long_biography.plain_text:
beIN's international expansion is Nasser Al-Khelaïfi's defining executive project. He led the transition from Al Jazeera Sport into a standalone sports and entertainment group, launching channels across the Middle East, Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and Australia. Under his chairmanship, the business broadened into general entertainment and added Digiturk and Miramax.

Before entering executive leadership, Al-Khelaïfi was a world-ranked tennis player who represented Qatar in the Davis Cup. He now chairs European Football Clubs and Premier Padel and leads Qatar's tennis, squash, padel and badminton federation. In the federation role, he oversees the country's principal annual ATP and WTA tournaments.
